newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma Bomb Jury decides on McVeigh sentence.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma Bomb Jury decides on McVeigh sentence.

text.p: The jury reached a decision on Friday on whether Timothy McVeigh should be executed or spend the rest of his life in jail for the 1995 Oklahoma City bombing, in which 168 people died, a court official said.
The jury's verdict, reached after 1-1/2 days of deliberations, will be announced at 3.20 p.m. (5.20 p.m. EDT). McVeigh was convicted of the devastating attack on June 2.
